Ellen (eng-ml): Quick follow-up from the latest postmortem on recurring eviction + rollback flaps. We need concrete eval additions so we stop seeing the same pattern in prod. Who can pick owners for regression cases, promptset, load profiles, and a chaos drill?
Marcus (eng-sre): I'll take the chaos drill + runbook updates. Plan: staged drill that simulates gradual KV degradation then a sudden partial eviction. Targeting Thu 10:30am staging. Need a small driver script and clear abort criteria.
Priya (eng-platform): I'll own infra + CI jobs. I can create a nightly job to run the new matrix and a lightweight PR smoke. Will provision a 3xA100 ephemeral cluster for the runs. Ticket STG-6033.
Toby (eng-ml): I'll own regression tests + promptset. Proposed regression axes: seq=[128,512,2048], batch=[1,8,32], kernel=[fp16,int8], cache=[cold,warm], rounding=[nearest,stochastic]. ETA: PR by Tue EOD.
Ellen (eng-ml): Add a promptset focusing on long-reference chains and token-repeat bursts. Also include synthetic burst-write traces we replayed in the postmortem.
Toby (eng-ml): Example test command I'll include in PR: `pytest tests/eviction/test_burst_replay.py::test_burst_then_read --env=staging --kernel=int8 --check-fallback`
Marcus (eng-sre): For the chaos driver I need `scripts/induce_kv_degradation --pct=30 --ramp=90 --safe` and abort conditions: sustained error_rate > 0.5% or infra quota > 85%. I'll add triage signals: kv_miss_rate, cache_eviction_rate, runtime.kernel_fallback_count.
Priya (eng-platform): CI gating plan: PR smoke uses seq=128,batch=1,kernel=int8; nightly runs full matrix. I'll add a Jenkins job `nightly/eviction-matrix` and hook the metric `runtime.kernel_fallback_count` to the canary dashboard.
Ellen (eng-ml): Pass criteria: 48h of nightly runs with no new eviction regressions and p95 latency within 10% of baseline. We'll close actions once criteria met.
Toby (eng-ml): One risk: quantized kernels + QAT changes might alter eviction timing. I'll add `--qat=true|false` to the matrix and include a short README explaining how to interpret fallback logs.
Marcus (eng-sre): I'll add a runbook rule: if `runtime.kernel_fallback_count{kernel="int8"} > 3` within 15m, escalate to on-call and run rollback checklist.
ActionBot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/pm/eviction-repeat-pattern  4 action_items assigned.
Ellen (eng-ml): Ownership summary for tracker: Toby=regressions+promptset (Tue), Marcus=chaos+runbook (Thu 10:30), Priya=infra+CI (Wed). I'll add the thread ts + PR links to the tracker and we'll do a short check in next standup.
Priya (eng-platform): Cluster provisioned STG-6033 and CI job scaffolded. Posting job URL and creds in tracker.
Toby (eng-ml): PR draft uploaded with tests and promptset. Linking in tracker: https://redwood/pr/eviction-regressions
Marcus (eng-sre): Drill scheduled Thu 10:30am. Will post the driver artifact link in PR and tag on-call.
Ellen (eng-ml): Thanks everyone. Mark items as "in progress" in the tracker and ping if you need extra infra or more time. We'll close after 48h of clean nightly runs.
